facts.text: Melanie went camping in the mountains with her family last week.

evidence.quote: Actually, I just took my fam camping in the mountains last week - it was a really nice time together!

facts.text: Melanie and her family explored nature, roasted marshmallows around a campfire, and went on a hike during their camping trip.

evidence.quote: We explored nature, roasted marshmallows around the campfire and even went on a hike.

facts.text: Melanie mentioned that the two younger kids in her family love nature.
Melanie expressed that family time matters to her and that she will never forget the camping trip.

evidence.quote: It was so special having these moments together as a family - I'll never forget it!
